tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search the public pages on OnMap.me: local businesses in the United States and unofficial pages for public places (parks, libraries, public offices, museums, stations, landmarks, sports venues). Returns name, kind, city, a one-line summary and the page address. Use get_page for the full facts.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full content of one OnMap.me page as markdown (hours, address, phone, prices, questions and answers, guides), with where the facts come from. For an unofficial page it also gives the place's official site, the day the facts were last checked there, and the source pages.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One guide of a page as markdown (a short how-to about that business or place). The guide slugs of a page are listed by get_page.

tools.name: check_handle
tools.description: Is onmap.me/@name free for a business to claim? Says why when it is not.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Runs OnMap.me's free check on any public website: can AI crawlers reach it, does it say what the business is, where it is and how to reach it, and what is missing. Returns each check with pass or fail and a short written read. Limited to a few checks an hour.

tools.name: about_onmap
tools.description: What OnMap.me is, what a page contains, what it costs and how its data is kept current, as one short markdown file.
